qc/runs/kittle-2026-10-09-r2/raw-evidence-index.json (scope only; row 28 is a static rubric-structure check and no runtime record bears on it)
evidence: No pair of criteria demands incompatible products (placeholders, not-available answers, oldest-first ordering, literal markup and refusal wording are consistent across functional, polish and visual), and most bundling is legitimate whole-flow grouping. However several observables are graded by two criteria, contrary to the file's own claim at tests/scored/functional/judge.toml:35 ('Each observable is graded in exactly one criterion.'). (1) PRIMARY: persistence (functional/judge.toml:250-265) item 3 absolutely requires that search as Harriet finds nothing for 'Probate', 'Insurer letter', 'Boundary note' and 'Temp JUDGE-P2'. None of these is noted before the restart inside persistence (setup a-c at :256-258 do not touch them); they are the outcomes of other criteria: 'Boundary note' exact-seven-day expiry = deleted_and_expired_messages Part B (:118-119, search 'rent review date' finds nothing); 'Insurer letter' purge on release = hold_scope_and_release step 6 (:150, 'searching "Insurer letter" finds nothing'); 'Probate' purge on timer shortening = timer_changes step 2 (:131); 'Temp JUDGE-P2' delete = message_links (:187). Item 1 likewise absolutely requires 'Harriet can open its earlier version' (:260), already graded by edits_and_stale_edit step 1 (:161). So an off-by-one boundary or a non-purging release is penalised twice, independent of whether restart durability works. This is exactly the pattern the Colderwater lesson (LESSONS line 28) told us to grade relative to a before-restart baseline. (2) Transcript edited mark: edits_and_stale_edit step 4 (:164, 'Fails ... if the transcript does not mark the edit') and search_and_transcript Part B step 3 (:244-245, 'edited mark ... wrong or missing') both fail an app whose transcript renders no edited marker. (3) Lesser cross-dimension overlaps: polish phone_matter (polish/judge.toml:44, scrollWidth equals viewport and box reachable) vs visual phone_chambers anchor 2 ('text clipped or box off screen'); polish transcript_print (line length, author/time set apart) vs visual transcript_page (reading width, author and time placed consistently); polish hold_mark (visible without hovering) vs visual retention_marks anchor 2 ('marks are easy to miss'); functional timer_changes step 1 ('shows 7 days beside the title') vs polish timer_label ('sits next to the matter title'). Positive-control reuse of linking (wall_mentions_and_links vs message_links) and deleting (several criteria) is setup coupling required by check 30, and the wrong-password refusal (functional rejection vs polish reason placement) grades different observables; I do not count those as duplicates. The gate overlaps carry zero weight. Not a P1: the double penalty is bounded (a boundary defect costs 3.0+2.0 of 32.5 functional weight instead of 3.0) and the golden passes both, but it distorts ranking between apps that differ only in one retention edge.
counterexample: Plausible broken-only-once app: everything correct and fully durable across restart, but expiry uses 'older than' instead of 'exactly seven days or older', so 'Boundary note: rent review date is 5 June.' stays visible. It correctly fails deleted_and_expired_messages (3.0), but persistence item 3 search 'Boundary note' also returns it, so persistence (2.0) fails too although its restart durability is perfect. Likewise an app whose hold release does not purge overdue messages loses hold_scope_and_release and persistence, and an app with no edited marker in the transcript loses both edits_and_stale_edit and search_and_transcript. Conversely a state-dependent failure: if timer_changes' session times out before shortening M-13, 'Probate' remains in the database and a fully correct app fails persistence.
suggested_fix: In persistence, note each item-3 search result (and the earlier-version view) before calling restart_app and grade only that it is unchanged after restart (or drop the other criteria's purges from persistence, saying they are scored elsewhere); remove the transcript edited-mark leg from either edits_and_stale_edit step 4 or search_and_transcript Part B; and narrow polish phone_matter/transcript_print/hold_mark/timer_label or the matching visual anchors so each layout observable is scored in one dimension only.
